rows.claim: The required RabbitMQ job runs the command its step was written to run.
rows.codePath: the step carries its continuation again, and check_workflow_steps_are_the_commands_they_look_like joins continuations, splits the script into the commands a shell would build, refuses one that begins with an option, and parses every runner call against that runner's own parser
rows.testResult: 8 cases on the workflow of the fixture repository, plus 3 on the reader itself
rows.negativeMutation: removing the backslash, splitting one line earlier, dropping --project, mixing --command with a category, an outage for an unstarted broker, an unbalanced quote and a folded scalar are each red

rows.claim: A cleanup failure of a broker run can never leave a green verdict.
rows.codePath: execute() produces the primary outcome, teardown() returns findings and never raises, a finding makes an otherwise green run red and a primary failure keeps its own exit code; the control thread carries its exception out and observes its stop request inside the readiness wait
rows.testResult: 8 cases driving main() with the process and Docker boundary replaced, plus the readiness case
rows.negativeMutation: returning the primary code alone turns the three green-child rows red; swallowing the thread's exception turns its row red; sleeping through the stop request turns the readiness case red
rows.evidence: record-0094/counterexample-replay.json rows teardown-false-green-restore, teardown-false-green-controller, teardown-false-green-down, primary-failure-keeps-its-code, controller-thread-exception, controller-stop-during-readiness

rows.claim: The outage boundary and the endpoint observer are proven where they are decided, not inferred from two passing broker cases.

rows.testResult: 15 cases: a confirmed interrupt, a refused interrupt, a refused restore, a runner that never answers, another schema version, another request, the opposite action, unreadable JSON, and the four orders of Fault and Ready

rows.claim: publish-load calls a run exact only when the set was read with nothing still counting.
rows.codePath: ObserveThenQuiesceThenRead runs the observation window, then a bounded stop, then the snapshot; Quiesce reads its budget rather than the exception because the consumer agent completes a cancelled stop; Outcome reports inconclusive without a standstill

rows.negativeMutation: reading before the stop, stopping before the window, treating a spent budget as a standstill and dropping the inconclusive verdict are each red
